prompt: Create a transparent orthographic image atlas with exactly 6 object rows and 6 view columns. The provided 3x2 contact sheet gives objects in left-to-right reading order; make those six objects the six atlas rows in that order. Six columns exactly front, top, right, left, bottom, rear. Center one matching view in each cell and keep consistent scale across views of each object. Preserve all identifiable source details, colors, materials, and geometry. Use axis-aligned orthographic cameras and no perspective or rotated views. Walls and partitions: front/rear show full upright face, side views are thin horizontal edge elevations, top/bottom show full footprint. Props and machinery: infer coherent front, plan, side, underside, and rear views. No text, labels, extra object, grid, border, shadows, or background. Transparent background.
